status: draft — issue #509, epic #507; revised by issue #518 (ADR-0039); read by scripts/contracts/contract.sh and the module's command. Format: docs/records/design-reviews/io-contract-modules.md > 5.
goal: The change the build made, its local tests recorded green in the build report, pushed to the target's remote and — unless the invocation says pull_request none — in draft pull requests on the base whose bodies show the change working and let the operator decide on them: as many pull requests as the change takes, in the repositories and on the branches it takes, sub-repos included. The output names each branch pushed, its head and its pull request.

base.note: the branch the pull request is to merge into; not given, the remote's default branch

pull_request.note: none: the branches are pushed and no pull request is opened; not given, open

timeout.note: the run's bound in seconds; not given, 900. Reaching it ends the run with its failure output

tool_requests.note: Besides the criteria, the PR body owes the operator the tool requests of every run (§5.3) and the recommendations deferred or separated. Each path is one run's tool-requests.json.

deferred.note: a JSON array of the recommendations deferred or separated, each {subject, finding, disposition}: the disposition is the issue that takes it (#<n>, or <owner>/<repo>#<n>) or the gap stated in one line

delivered.note: {pull_requests: [{repo: <owner>/<name>, branch, head, pr: <owner>/<name>#<N>}]} — each branch pushed, its head and its pull request; pr null under pull_request none. The review's pr and the ci module's input are an entry's pr

failure.note: Written instead of the expected output when the run does not reach its goal, or reaches its timeout: what the run did and why it did not reach the goal — an input it needed and was not given named as such. check-out then writes `failed` (docs/units/delivery.md > What both modules owe).
